metadata.description: Myna — a Claude Code plugin that sends the questions Claude asks you to your phone.

plugins.name: myna
plugins.description: Async human-gate bridge — send Claude Code questions and decision gates to your phone via Telegram, Discord, or Slack (blocking MCP ask_human + local relay). Autopilot auto-accept + decision log, reply threading, /myna:* commands, auto-start relay.
